title_original: 변호사ㆍ법무사의 자격이 있는 보증인의 보수에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Remuneration Where Guarantee Services Can No Longer Be Performed)
Where a qualified guarantor becomes unable to perform guarantee services after commencing such services for any of the following reasons, the qualified guarantor may receive remuneration not exceeding 60 percent of the remuneration agreed upon under the main sentence of Article 2, excluding its subparagraphs:
1. Where the person seeking issuance of a confirmation so requests;
2. Where the inability results from circumstances attributable to the person seeking issuance of a confirmation.
